remarks: Please submit highest & best offers by 5pm Monday, 10/28. Rebuilt in 2000 and completely renovated between 2022-2024, 147 Hoyt St is the one you've been waiting for! The elegant and sprawling first floor features a stunning custom kitchen with walnut cabinetry, Calacatta Monet countertops, Thermador appliances, unlacquered brass hardware, and minimalist Prado outlets. The kitchen flows seamlessly into the great room with soaring vaulted ceilings and stone fireplace. Perfect for entertaining, the floor plan is open and cohesive while still maintaining distinct spaces, including the living room and formal dining. The stunning primary suite was completely reimagined with a custom walk-in closet, bathroom with soaking tub, and bedroom with vaulted ceilings. An additional bedroom completes the first level. Upstairs you'll find two additional bedrooms with a jack and jill bathroom and sitting area, which overlooks the great room. Don't miss the lower level, featuring a top-of-the-line gym and media room. Completely smart enabled with Ring alarm system, new thermostats, Kasa light switches and bulbs, and more. Numerous other updates include new AC system, extensive exterior landscaping and a full house water filtration system. You can truly turn the key and move right in to this Darien gem! This home is also part of the Boulder Ridge Assoc. and has access to the tennis court and playground!
